scope: Frozen control assignments, automatic learning exclusions and paired human-score regression gates
changes: Partition the 25 existing synthetic services cases into 10 draft controls and 15 training candidates; no approved answers generated.
Imported planned control questions and their benchmark versions are excluded from learning before human scores exist; frozen custom sets additionally exclude IDs and exact question duplicates.
Create immutable snapshots of approved benchmark membership and exact approval hashes without a database migration.
Compare the same tasks and expert cohorts using scores created after set creation; reject missing or ambiguous pairs and changed reviews.
Give each task equal weight, and flag regression in any individual pair even if averages improve; a newly missed risk index is a regression even if missed-risk counts are unchanged.
Allow experts to explicitly attribute their own single score to a second label for a declared identical output; do not manufacture duplicate scores or claim actual run verification.
Add workspace forms, HTTP routes, review-route restrictions and shipped-file/config verification.

checks_include: Automatic exclusion of frozen IDs, exact question copies and reserved imported control tasks.
Invalidation of already selected learning when a benchmark becomes a control.
Averages improve but an individual task regresses: gate blocks.
New missed risk with unchanged count: gate blocks.
Missing, ambiguous, pre-freeze and mismatched-reviewer scores do not pass.
Human identity/access, changed approval records, corrupted responses and explicit identical-answer attribution.
Backup restoration preserves controls and their learning exclusions; old restored tokens stay disabled.
Real HTTP round trip with synthetic scores; UI rejects late responses after identity/parameter changes.

limitations: Expert qualification and actual model-run provenance are not automatically authenticated.
Exact question matching cannot eliminate every paraphrase or cross-source contamination; independent data preparation remains necessary.
A no-regression gate permits expert consideration only, never automatic model/memory/code deployment.
Control/alias records have no API release or automatic expiry; target retention and recovery remain operational acceptance requirements.
Real model/search configuration, Chromium browser acceptance, independent lawyer review and complete source coverage remain open.
